CPV.note: No cable or international fibre route is mentioned.
Only subscription counts (500,263 internet access subscriptions) and operator traffic shares are given, no share of people using the internet.

facts.fact: Starlink held 0.87% of Cabo Verde's internet access subscriptions at the end of June 2026 and 18% of national internet traffic in the second quarter of 2026, up from 6% a year earlier, according to the regulator ARME.
ARME's report for the second quarter of 2026 gives Starlink's share of internet access subscriptions in Cabo Verde as 0.87%, against 72.6% for Cabo Verde Telecom and 26.5% for Unitel.
